title: Telepearl
description: This mod adds a variant of the Ender Pearl, which lets you teleport anywhere in the world by right clicking with it in your hand, and then inputting your desired coordinates. You can choose to teleport from your relative position, or to your spawn point.
body: This mod is a mod which lets you teleport anywhere you want, just with a single item. You can choose between choosing if you want to use relative positioning, or teleporting to your spawn point. You can also change the cooldown using a game rule: ``` /gamerule telepearlCooldown 60 ```, or you can make the cooldown also work in creative mode using this command: ``` /gamerule useCooldownInCreative true ```.
